title: kate-ui: bind option-arrow to word movement
summary: alt-left and alt-right move by word. alt-shift-left and alt-shift-right extend by word. option-left uses the same command. The test goes in the existing keys tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: keys.rs has 657 lines. Edit only the MOVE_BINDINGS array and the existing test module. The file has one test module named tests. Add the new function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Add four rows before the closing bracket of MOVE_BINDINGS. The stored names are the normalized names. The modifier order is ctrl, alt, shift, cmd. alt-left is Movement::WordLeft and Extend::No. alt-right is Movement::WordRight and Extend::No. alt-shift-left is Movement::WordLeft and Extend::Yes. alt-shift-right is Movement::WordRight and Extend::Yes. Leave left, right, home, end, cmd-left, and ctrl-6 as they are. The test alt_arrow_moves_by_word calls command_for_binding. alt-left and option-left return Move WordLeft Extend::No. alt-right returns Move WordRight Extend::No. shift-alt-left and alt-shift-left return Move WordLeft Extend::Yes. alt-shift-right returns Move WordRight Extend::Yes. left still returns Move Left Extend::No. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines.

regression_tests.name: keys::tests::alt_arrow_moves_by_word
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because alt-left returns None. After the change alt-left and option-left move one word left. alt-right moves one word right. shift-alt-left and alt-shift-left extend one word left. alt-shift-right extends one word right. left still moves one scalar left.
